name: Canara Bank
business_summary: Canara Bank (govt ownership 62.93%) is a top-four PSU bank with a strong South-India retail, agri and gold-loan franchise and subsidiaries in asset management (Canara Robeco), life insurance (Canara HSBC Life) and others. Q2 FY27: PAT Rs5,175cr (+8.4% y/y), NII Rs11,005cr, NIM 2.55%, GNPA 1.33%, NNPA 0.30%, advances +19.5% y/y, total business Rs30.72 lakh cr (+15.9%). Treasury losses weighed and on 2026-10-15 management flagged a one-time ECL provision of Rs12-15k cr recognised over ~2 years (CET1 12.80%, no equity raise planned). P/B 0.86, P/E 5.45, dividend yield 3.5%.

exposures.mechanism: Larger than BoB: investment book ~Rs5 lakh cr, AFS/FVTPL ~Rs1.6 lakh cr (model estimate) x duration 3 x 0.25% = ~Rs1,200cr pre-tax (~0.8% of Rs1.107 lakh cr mcap post-tax); Q2 already carried treasury losses (ET 2026-10-15). Cost-of-equity channel: P/B 0.86, +25bp G-sec => ~50% to CoE => P/B ~-2.4%. Sum ~-3.2; trimmed for reversal and higher asset yields. 10y 7.4-7.5% in Oct.

evidence.note: India 10y G-sec ~7.4-7.5% in Oct 2026, multi-year high (Reuters/ET headlines); Nov outlook 7.25-7.35%

exposures.mechanism: ~50% of domestic advances repo/EBLR-linked (model knowledge); deposits reprice with lag. +25bp: ~Rs6 lakh cr x 0.25% = Rs1,500cr gross, ~60% offset over 6m => ~2bp NIM on ~Rs17.3 lakh cr earning assets (NII 11,005x4/2.55%) = ~Rs350cr = ~1.6% of annualised PAT Rs21,500cr; x persistence 0.5 => ~+0.8, less demand/credit-cost drag => +0.4. NIM guide 2.5-2.6%, 'floor 2.5%'.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (The Hindu, Reuters headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +50bp credit cost x ~Rs12 lakh cr advances = Rs6,000cr pre-tax = Rs4,500cr post-tax = ~21% of annualised PAT Rs21,500cr; x persistence 0.4 x EV/MCap 1.0 => -8.4; trimmed to -7.0 since GNPA is at a record-low 1.33% (cycle risk asymmetrical) but the stock is cheap. 23 straight quarters of NNPA improvement.

exposures.mechanism: Retail unsecured ~3-4% of book (model estimate) = ~Rs45,000cr; +1pp delinquency x LGD 70% = ~Rs315cr pre-tax = ~1.1% PAT x 0.4 => -0.4.

Management-disclosed one-time ECL provision Rs12-15k cr (some Rs2-3k cr is HTM MTM), recognised over ~1-2 yrs, CET1 12.80% / CRAR 17.19%, no fresh equity planned. Rs15,000cr = 13.5% of Rs1.107 lakh cr mcap pre-tax, ~10% post-tax; the stock already fell 6% on disclosure and management says it is absorbable => residual ~-4.5 (wide range, dilution possible).

NIM floor 2.5%, absorb ECL without fresh equity

exposures.mechanism: +Rs1 lakh cr surplus lowers CD/CP and bulk deposit costs ~2bp on ~Rs17 lakh cr => ~Rs340cr = 1.6% PAT x 0.25 => +0.4; RBI's Oct liquidity-tightening measures are a headwind.

FII share fell from 14.2% (Mar 2026) to 12.3% (Sep 2026), i.e. already net selling; market beta 1.40-1.46 is the highest among PSU banks. +US$5bn/qtr ~ +3% Nifty => ~+4.3% for beta 1.43, of which about half survives demeaning of the market factor.
Lead lender to infra/PSU capex; +10% capex growth => corporate credit +~0.7pp => ~+0.9% PAT x 0.5 => +0.8.
Agri ~20% of advances (model knowledge, strong rural/agri franchise); +10% above-LPA monsoon lowers agri slippages ~10bp on Rs2.4 lakh cr => ~Rs240cr pre-tax = ~1.1% PAT x 0.4 => +0.4.

Gold loans (agri/retail) are a growth engine; +8% gold raises collateral value and loan sizes: gold loans ~Rs1.2 lakh cr (model estimate) x 4% => +Rs4,800cr balances x spread 3% = ~Rs140cr = ~0.5% PAT => +0.5. Pack: -0.30 (t -0.4) - not significant, sign differs; weak evidence either way. Gold -8% since June.

Listed subsidiaries/associates (Canara Robeco AMC 51%, Canara HSBC Life - listed in 2025 per model knowledge, verify) gain from SIP/DII flows; combined stake value est. 5-10% of mcap; +10% flows lifts their value ~5-8% => +0.5.
